\makepapertitle
\begin{paperabstract}
Layout tools disagree because their cost functions disagree. We define a
general cost function: a weighted sum of geometry-derived metrics over
mono, bigram, skipgram and trigram statistics plus a few non-linear
balance terms, parameterized by a board, a corpus and a profile, and we
ask what makes such a function good. We test it three ways:
\textbf{sensitivity} (how far the optimum moves with the weights),
\textbf{validity} (agreement with independent judges: Engram comfort,
keystroke timing, community preference) and \textbf{robustness}
(transfer across corpora and boards). {[}TODO: key findings.{]} We give
a recipe for a defensible default profile and report where the evidence
is weak.

\end{paperabstract}
\begin{paperbody}
\section{Research questions}

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\arabic{enumi}.}
\setlength{\itemsep}{1pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
\item
  RQ1 \emph{Expressiveness}: which metric families are needed (ablation:
  drop a family, measure what changes in rankings and optima)?
\item
  RQ2 \emph{Sensitivity}: how many optimum families does the plausible
  weight space contain; which weights decide between them (Sobol
  indices)?
\item
  RQ3 \emph{Validity}: how well does the score predict (a) IKI from 136M
  keystrokes, (b) Engram pairwise comfort, (c) community likes, (d) a
  small user study?
\item
  RQ4 \emph{Goodhart}: does more search effort widen the gap between
  proxy and judge?
\item
  RQ5 \emph{Transfer}: does a profile fitted on one corpus/board hold on
  others (english, shai, reddit, mt-10k, french, code; ANSI-30, Corne)?
\end{enumerate}

\section{Hypotheses (not results)}

H1 a few families explain most ranking changes. H2 two or three weights
dominate the optimum. H3 geometry-based metrics transfer better than
trigram metrics. H4 learned pair-feature weights beat hand-set weights
on held-out typists, but only modestly. H5 the proxy-vs-judge gap grows
with search effort unless the judge is part of the objective.

\section{Method}

\begin{itemize}
\setlength{\itemsep}{1pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
\item
  Definition: \texttt{context/objective.md} (folding, spread-normalized
  weights, non-linear terms).
\item
  Sensitivity: Latin-hypercube over log-scaled spread-normalized
  weights; archive once with \texttt{gecko\ explore}, re-rank under each
  vector (\texttt{gecko\ atlas\ -p}); embedding by finger distance.
\item
  Validity: IKI regression on geometric pair features, split by typist;
  pairwise logistic fit
  (\texttt{gecko\ profile\ fit\ -\/-target\ likes}) with bootstrap CIs;
  judges never used to train and test the same claim.
\item
  Goodhart: budget grid 1 s \ldots{} 10 min; optimize profile A, score
  on B, C and E05.
\item
  Pre-register the analysis (cluster definition, cutoffs) before
  running.
\end{itemize}

\section{Existing evidence}

Timing validity, comfort agreement, weight robustness and a 600-run
weight sweep: the experiment report \texttt{docs/papers/cost-validity/}
(\texttt{research/experiments/2026-10-22-cost-function-validity.md}).
The default profile was retuned from it on 2026-10-22; a sweep of the
new default is in \texttt{bench/sweep-2026-10-22/}, and SFS timing by
context in \texttt{research/experiments/2026-10-22-skipgram-timing.md}.
Held-out pairwise accuracy 53.78 \% (learned) vs 51.96 \% (default) vs
49.40 \% (Engram E05)
(\texttt{research/experiments/2026-10-21-profile-ranking.md}; no CIs
yet). An earlier optimum (8.396) ranked last on E05 after the profile
changed; B11 at weight 1 re-sorts Halmak and Colemak
(\texttt{context/objective.md}).

\section{Figures}

F1 metric-family ablation · F2 optimum embedding by weight vector · F3
Sobol bars · F4 regret matrix · F5 validity: predicted vs observed (IKI
heatmap by finger pair; accuracy with CIs) · F6 proxy-vs-judge along
search · F7 transfer matrix · F8 consensus keyboard.

\section{Threats}

Timing data is from QWERTY typists (learn geometric, never per-letter
costs); likes measure popularity; E05 comes from one study; hand model
parameters from literature; no user study yet.

\section{Needed}

Bootstrap CIs on the ranking fits; Sobol indices over the weights;
ideally a 10–20 person study (timing and pairwise comfort, including
SFS).
